<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />

    <title>Mission Control</title>
    <style>:root {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --mc-bg: var(--background, #0d0e11);
  --mc-rail-bg: #0b0c0f;
  --mc-inspector-bg: #0f1014;
  --mc-card: var(--card, #14161b);
  --mc-surface: var(--muted, #1a1d24);
  --mc-surface-active: #1f232c;
  --mc-tab-active: #252932;
  --mc-fg: var(--foreground, #f3f4f6);
  --mc-fg-2: var(--secondary-foreground, #d1d5db);
  --mc-fg-muted: var(--muted-foreground, #8b92a1);
  --mc-fg-faint: #616876;

  --mc-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --mc-border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
  --mc-border-active: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  --mc-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);
  --mc-press: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

  --mc-primary-bg: #f4f5f7;
  --mc-primary-fg: #0d0e11;
  --mc-accent: var(--primary, #38bdf8);

  --mc-green: #34d399;
  --mc-green-text: #4ade80;
  --mc-green-bg: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.12);
  --mc-green-border: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.28);

  --mc-amber: #e5a93c;
  --mc-amber-text: #f3c669;
  --mc-amber-bg: rgba(229, 169, 60, 0.14);
  --mc-amber-border: rgba(229, 169, 60, 0.3);

  --mc-blue: #38bdf8;
  --mc-blue-text: #60c5f8;
  --mc-blue-bg: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
  --mc-blue-border: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.28);

  --mc-red: #ef4444;
  --mc-red-text: #f87171;
  --mc-red-bg: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12);
  --mc-red-border: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28);

  --mc-gray: #6b7280;

  --mc-font: var(
    --font-family,
    "Public Sans",
    "Google Sans",
    system-ui,
    -apple-system,
    BlinkMacSystemFont,
    "Segoe UI",
    Roboto,
    sans-serif
  );
  --mc-mono: var(
    --editor-font-family,
    "JetBrains Mono",
    ui-monospace,
    SFMono-Regular,
    Menlo,
    Monaco,
    Consolas,
    monospace
  );

  --r-sm: 5px;
  --r-md: 8px;
  --r-lg: 10px;
  --r-xl: 12px;
}

:root[data-theme="light"] {
  color-scheme: light;
  --mc-bg: var(--background, #f5f6f8);
  --mc-rail-bg: #eef0f4;
  --mc-inspector-bg: #fafbfc;
  --mc-card: var(--card, #ffffff);
  --mc-surface: var(--muted, #f0f2f5);
  --mc-surface-active: #e7ebf2;
  --mc-tab-active: #e4e7ee;
  --mc-fg: var(--foreground, #111827);
  --mc-fg-2: var(--secondary-foreground, #374151);
  --mc-fg-muted: var(--muted-foreground, #5f6775);
  --mc-fg-faint: #8e96a4;

  --mc-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1);
  --mc-border-subtle: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
  --mc-border-active: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.24);
  --mc-hover: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
  --mc-press: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);

  --mc-primary-bg: #111827;
  --mc-primary-fg: #ffffff;

  --mc-green-text: #15803d;
  --mc-green-bg: rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.1);
  --mc-green-border: rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.25);

  --mc-amber-text: #b45309;
  --mc-amber-bg: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.12);
  --mc-amber-border: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.28);

  --mc-blue-text: #0369a1;
  --mc-blue-bg: rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.1);
  --mc-blue-border: rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.26);

  --mc-red-text: #b91c1c;
  --mc-red-bg: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.1);
  --mc-red-border: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.24);
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html,
body {
  height: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--mc-bg);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  font-family: var(--mc-font);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

button,
input,
select,
textarea {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
}

button {
  cursor: pointer;
}

:focus {
  outline: none;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mc-accent) 75%, transparent);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

.hidden {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Scrollbars */
* {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: rgba(128, 136, 152, 0.26) transparent;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(128, 136, 152, 0.24);
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

.mc-icon {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  flex: none;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}
.mc-icon .fill {
  fill: currentColor;
  stroke: none;
}

/* Status Dots */
.mc-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex: none;
  background: var(--mc-gray);
}
.mc-dot.tone-green,
.mc-dot.tone-success {
  background: var(--mc-green);
}
.mc-dot.tone-amber,
.mc-dot.tone-warning {
  background: var(--mc-amber);
}
.mc-dot.tone-blue,
.mc-dot.tone-info {
  background: var(--mc-blue);
}
.mc-dot.tone-red,
.mc-dot.tone-error {
  background: var(--mc-red);
}
.mc-dot.tone-gray,
.mc-dot.tone-idle,
.mc-dot.tone-muted {
  background: var(--mc-gray);
}

/* 3-Column Desktop Shell */
.mc-shell {
  display: flex;
  height: 100vh;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--mc-bg);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  font-family: var(--mc-font);
}

.mc-shell.is-full-width .mc-inspector {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Left 44px Icon Rail */
.mc-rail {
  width: 44px;
  flex: 0 0 44px;
  background: var(--mc-rail-bg);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 12px 0;
  gap: 8px;
  z-index: 20;
}

.mc-rail-btn {
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition:
    background 0.12s ease,
    color 0.12s ease,
    border-color 0.12s ease;
}

.mc-rail-btn:hover {
  background: var(--mc-hover);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-rail-btn.active {
  background: var(--mc-surface-active);
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-rail-spacer {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

/* Center Workspace */
.mc-workspace {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  padding: 18px 22px 28px;
}

.mc-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.mc-header-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.mc-title-group {
  min-width: 0;
}

.mc-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1.2;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-subtitle {
  margin: 3px 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.mc-mode-chip {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--mc-amber-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-amber-border);
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.mc-segmented {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  max-width: 100%;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 3px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
}

.mc-seg-btn {
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition:
    background 0.12s ease,
    color 0.12s ease;
}

.mc-seg-btn:hover:not(.active) {
  background: var(--mc-hover);
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
}

.mc-seg-btn.active {
  background: var(--mc-tab-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}

:root[data-theme="light"] .mc-seg-btn.active {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14);
}

.mc-header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.mc-btn-primary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  background: var(--mc-primary-bg);
  color: var(--mc-primary-fg);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    opacity 0.12s ease,
    transform 0.08s ease;
}

.mc-btn-primary:hover {
  opacity: 0.92;
}

.mc-btn-primary:active {
  transform: translateY(0.5px);
}

.mc-btn-plus {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.mc-header-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.mc-filter-group {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 3px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
}

.mc-filter-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  padding: 4px 9px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.mc-filter-pill:hover {
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-filter-pill.active {
  background: var(--mc-tab-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-pill-count {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0 5px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  line-height: 16px;
}

.mc-pill-count.tone-amber {
  background: var(--mc-amber-bg);
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
}

.mc-pill-count.tone-green {
  background: var(--mc-green-bg);
  color: var(--mc-green-text);
}

.mc-search-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  width: 244px;
  height: 32px;
  padding: 0 8px 0 9px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  gap: 6px;
}

.mc-search-wrap:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
}

.mc-search-icon {
  color: var(--mc-fg-faint);
}

.mc-search-input {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  font-size: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-search-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--mc-fg-faint);
}

.mc-search-input::-webkit-search-cancel-button {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
}

.mc-kbd {
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  font-family: var(--mc-font);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.3;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Section Headers */
.mc-section-title {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.mc-section + .mc-section {
  margin-top: 20px;
}

/* Needs Attention Strip */
.mc-attention-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

.mc-attention-card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px 12px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(229, 169, 60, 0.11) 0%,
    rgba(229, 169, 60, 0.025) 45%,
    var(--mc-card) 100%
  );
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color 0.14s ease;
}

.mc-attention-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 3px;
  background: var(--mc-amber);
}

.mc-attention-card.kind-error::before,
.mc-attention-card.kind-quota::before {
  background: var(--mc-red);
}

.mc-attention-card.kind-error,
.mc-attention-card.kind-quota {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.11) 0%,
    rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.025) 45%,
    var(--mc-card) 100%
  );
}

.mc-attention-card.kind-done::before {
  background: var(--mc-green);
}

.mc-attention-card.kind-done {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.11) 0%,
    rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.025) 45%,
    var(--mc-card) 100%
  );
}

.mc-attention-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
}

.mc-attention-main {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.mc-attention-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.mc-attention-badge {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: var(--mc-amber-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-amber-border);
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.mc-attention-card.kind-error .mc-attention-badge,
.mc-attention-card.kind-quota .mc-attention-badge {
  background: var(--mc-red-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-red-border);
  color: var(--mc-red-text);
}

.mc-attention-card.kind-done .mc-attention-badge {
  background: var(--mc-green-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-green-border);
  color: var(--mc-green-text);
}

.mc-attention-project {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-attention-title {
  margin: 1px 0 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-attention-title:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 2px;
}

.mc-attention-summary {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-attention-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 6px;
  flex: none;
}

.mc-attention-actions.is-bottom-row {
  justify-content: flex-end;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.mc-btn-subtle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    background 0.12s ease,
    border-color 0.12s ease,
    color 0.12s ease;
}

.mc-btn-subtle:hover {
  background: var(--mc-surface-active);
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-btn-subtle.is-strong {
  background: var(--mc-surface-active);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

:root[data-theme="light"] .mc-btn-subtle.is-strong {
  border-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.22);
}

.mc-btn-subtle:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* Projects 2x2 Grid */
.mc-projects-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

.mc-project-card {
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  transition: border-color 0.14s ease;
}

.mc-project-card.is-active {
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
}

.mc-project-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 11px 12px 10px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mc-border-subtle);
}

.mc-project-ident {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.mc-project-folder {
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

.mc-project-name {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-branch-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  font-family: var(--mc-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.mc-branch-pill .mc-icon {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

.mc-diff-mini {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.05;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-left: 2px;
}

.mc-diff-add {
  color: var(--mc-green-text);
}

.mc-diff-del {
  color: var(--mc-red-text);
}

.mc-head-spacer {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

.mc-status-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

.mc-status-badge.tone-green {
  background: var(--mc-green-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-green-border);
  color: var(--mc-green-text);
}

.mc-status-badge.tone-amber {
  background: var(--mc-amber-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-amber-border);
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
}

.mc-status-badge.tone-blue {
  background: var(--mc-blue-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-blue-border);
  color: var(--mc-blue-text);
}

.mc-status-badge.tone-red {
  background: var(--mc-red-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-red-border);
  color: var(--mc-red-text);
}

.mc-icon-btn {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: none;
}

.mc-icon-btn:hover {
  background: var(--mc-hover);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-project-body {
  padding: 7px 10px 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

.mc-thread-row {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 7px 9px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  text-align: left;
  transition:
    background 0.12s ease,
    border-color 0.12s ease;
}

.mc-thread-row:hover {
  background: var(--mc-hover);
}

.mc-thread-row.selected {
  background: var(--mc-surface-active);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

:root[data-theme="light"] .mc-thread-row.selected {
  border-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16);
}

.mc-thread-row .mc-dot {
  margin-top: 5px;
}

.mc-thread-main {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
}

.mc-thread-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-thread-sub {
  margin-top: 1px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-thread-sub.tone-amber {
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.mc-thread-right {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding-top: 1px;
  flex: none;
}

.mc-thread-right.tone-amber {
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.mc-inline-launch {
  margin-top: 2px;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--mc-border);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015);
  color: var(--mc-fg-faint);
  font-size: 12px;
  text-align: left;
  transition:
    background 0.12s ease,
    border-color 0.12s ease,
    color 0.12s ease;
}

.mc-inline-launch:hover {
  background: var(--mc-hover);
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
}

.mc-project-foot {
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--mc-border-subtle);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

/* Right-Hand Thread Inspector */
.mc-inspector {
  width: 380px;
  flex: 0 0 380px;
  background: var(--mc-inspector-bg);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 30;
}

.mc-insp-head {
  padding: 14px 16px 0;
  flex: none;
}

.mc-insp-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.mc-insp-crumb-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.mc-insp-back {
  display: none;
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.mc-insp-crumb {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-insp-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.mc-insp-status.tone-green {
  color: var(--mc-green-text);
}
.mc-insp-status.tone-amber {
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
}
.mc-insp-status.tone-blue {
  color: var(--mc-blue-text);
}
.mc-insp-status.tone-red {
  color: var(--mc-red-text);
}

.mc-insp-title-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.mc-insp-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-btn-open-full {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 4px 9px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex: none;
}

.mc-btn-open-full:hover {
  background: var(--mc-surface-active);
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-btn-open-full .mc-icon {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
}

/* Inspector Underline Tabs */
.mc-insp-tabs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  flex: none;
}

.mc-insp-tab {
  position: relative;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  padding: 8px 2px 10px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

.mc-insp-tab:hover {
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
}

.mc-insp-tab.active {
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-insp-tab.active::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -1px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--mc-fg);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.mc-tab-badge {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0 5px;
  line-height: 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--mc-surface-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
}

.mc-insp-body {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

/* Roster Strip Card */
.mc-roster-strip {
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  padding: 9px 11px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
}

.mc-roster-chip {
  flex: 0 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.mc-roster-name {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-roster-state {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  padding-left: 12px;
}

/* Activity Cards */
.mc-activity-card {
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  padding: 11px 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
}

.mc-activity-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
}

.mc-activity-actors {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
}

.mc-agent-avatar {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--mc-amber-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-amber-border);
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: none;
}

.mc-agent-avatar .mc-icon {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
}

.mc-activity-arrow {
  color: var(--mc-fg-faint);
}

.mc-activity-time {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex: none;
}

.mc-activity-text {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
  word-break: break-word;
}

.mc-activity-foot {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.mc-check-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  background: var(--mc-green-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-green-border);
  color: var(--mc-green-text);
}

.mc-check-pill.tone-amber {
  background: var(--mc-amber-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-amber-border);
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
}

.mc-check-pill.tone-red {
  background: var(--mc-red-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-red-border);
  color: var(--mc-red-text);
}

.mc-check-pill .mc-icon {
  width: 13px;
  height: 13px;
}

.mc-code-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  font-family: var(--mc-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
}

.mc-state-text {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

.mc-mention {
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Swarm Tab List */
.mc-swarm-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.mc-swarm-member-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
}

.mc-swarm-member-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.mc-swarm-member-role {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

/* Files Tab */
.mc-files-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.mc-file-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  text-align: left;
  width: 100%;
  transition:
    border-color 0.12s ease,
    background 0.12s ease;
}

.mc-file-row:hover {
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
}

.mc-file-status {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--mc-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  flex: none;
  background: var(--mc-amber-bg);
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
}

.mc-file-status.status-A {
  background: var(--mc-green-bg);
  color: var(--mc-green-text);
}

.mc-file-status.status-D {
  background: var(--mc-red-bg);
  color: var(--mc-red-text);
}

.mc-file-path {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--mc-mono);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-file-stats {
  font-family: var(--mc-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 6px;
  flex: none;
}

/* Diff Tab */
.mc-diff-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 5px;
}

.mc-diff-chip {
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  font-family: var(--mc-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
}

.mc-diff-chip.active {
  background: var(--mc-surface-active);
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-diff-block {
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.mc-diff-file-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  font-family: var(--mc-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
}

.mc-diff-pre {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 6px 0;
  font-family: var(--mc-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.mc-diff-line {
  display: block;
  padding: 0 10px;
  white-space: pre;
}

.mc-diff-line.is-add {
  background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.11);
  color: var(--mc-green-text);
}

.mc-diff-line.is-del {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.11);
  color: var(--mc-red-text);
}

.mc-diff-line.is-hunk {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
  color: var(--mc-blue-text);
}

.mc-diff-line.is-ctx {
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

/* Docked Bottom Composer */
.mc-composer-wrap {
  padding: 10px 14px 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--mc-border-subtle);
  flex: none;
}

.mc-composer {
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 10px 11px 8px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.mc-composer:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
}

.mc-composer-input {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 36px;
  max-height: 120px;
  resize: none;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.mc-composer-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--mc-fg-faint);
}

.mc-composer-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 6px;
}

.mc-composer-left,
.mc-composer-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.mc-select-inline {
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 3px 6px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  max-width: 165px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.mc-select-inline:hover {
  background: var(--mc-hover);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-select-inline option {
  background: var(--mc-card);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-send-btn {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: var(--mc-primary-bg);
  color: var(--mc-primary-fg);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: none;
  transition:
    opacity 0.12s ease,
    transform 0.08s ease;
}

.mc-send-btn:hover {
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.mc-send-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.38;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.mc-send-btn .mc-icon {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
}

/* Kanban Board View */
.mc-board-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: start;
}

.mc-board-col {
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 240px;
}

.mc-board-col-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 2px 4px 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mc-border-subtle);
}

.mc-board-col-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-board-card {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  transition:
    border-color 0.12s ease,
    background 0.12s ease;
}

.mc-board-card[role="button"]:hover {
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
}

.mc-board-card.selected {
  background: var(--mc-surface-active);
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
}

.mc-board-card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

/* Timeline View */
.mc-timeline {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
}

.mc-tl-bucket-title {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

.mc-tl-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.mc-tl-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 76px 88px 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  text-align: left;
  width: 100%;
  transition:
    border-color 0.12s ease,
    background 0.12s ease;
}

.mc-tl-row:hover {
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
  background: var(--mc-surface);
}

.mc-tl-row.selected {
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
  background: var(--mc-surface-active);
}

.mc-tl-time {
  font-family: var(--mc-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

.mc-tl-kind {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  text-align: center;
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
}

.mc-tl-kind.tone-amber {
  background: var(--mc-amber-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-amber-border);
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
}

.mc-tl-kind.tone-blue {
  background: var(--mc-blue-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-blue-border);
  color: var(--mc-blue-text);
}

.mc-tl-kind.tone-green {
  background: var(--mc-green-bg);
  border-color: var(--mc-green-border);
  color: var(--mc-green-text);
}

.mc-tl-main {
  min-width: 0;
}

.mc-tl-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-tl-sub {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.mc-tl-proj {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Graph View */
.mc-graph-wrap {
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.mc-graph-legend {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

.mc-graph-legend-items {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.mc-graph-legend-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

.mc-graph-scroll {
  overflow: auto;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--mc-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border-subtle);
}

.mc-graph-svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 680px;
  height: auto;
}

.mc-graph-edge {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--mc-border-active);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  opacity: 0.55;
  transition:
    opacity 0.14s ease,
    stroke 0.14s ease,
    stroke-width 0.14s ease;
}

.mc-graph-edge.is-highlight {
  opacity: 1;
  stroke: var(--mc-amber);
  stroke-width: 2.2;
}

.mc-graph-node {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.mc-graph-node-rect {
  fill: var(--mc-card);
  stroke: var(--mc-border);
  stroke-width: 1;
  transition:
    stroke 0.14s ease,
    fill 0.14s ease;
}

.mc-graph-node:hover .mc-graph-node-rect,
.mc-graph-node.selected .mc-graph-node-rect {
  fill: var(--mc-surface-active);
  stroke: var(--mc-border-active);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.mc-graph-col-label {
  fill: var(--mc-fg-faint);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.mc-graph-node-label {
  fill: var(--mc-fg);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.mc-graph-node-sub {
  fill: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  font-size: 10.5px;
}

/* Empty States */
.mc-empty {
  padding: 36px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.mc-empty-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.mc-empty-sub {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 440px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

.mc-empty-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

/* Backdrop, Drawers, Popovers, Modals */
.mc-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.56);
  z-index: 40;
}

.mc-drawer {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 44px;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 340px;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 44px);
  background: var(--mc-inspector-bg);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  z-index: 50;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 16px;
  gap: 12px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: 12px 0 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

.mc-popover {
  position: fixed;
  left: 52px;
  bottom: 14px;
  width: 280px;
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border-active);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 14px;
  z-index: 55;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.mc-modal-root {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.62);
  z-index: 70;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 68px 16px 24px;
}

.mc-modal {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 500px;
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border-active);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 54px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.mc-modal-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
}

.mc-modal-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.mc-modal-body {
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  max-height: 70vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.mc-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
}

.mc-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
}

.mc-input,
.mc-select,
.mc-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}

.mc-textarea {
  min-height: 92px;
  resize: vertical;
}

.mc-modal-foot {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
}

/* Floating (Draggable & Resizable) Modal */
.mc-modal-floating {
  position: fixed;
  width: 520px;
  max-width: none;
  min-width: 360px;
  min-height: 360px;
  overflow: visible;
}

.mc-modal-floating .mc-modal-head {
  cursor: grab;
  user-select: none;
  border-top-left-radius: var(--r-xl);
  border-top-right-radius: var(--r-xl);
}

.mc-modal-floating.is-dragging .mc-modal-head {
  cursor: grabbing;
}

.mc-modal-floating.is-dragging,
.mc-modal-floating.is-resizing {
  user-select: none;
  box-shadow: 0 28px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
}

.mc-modal-head-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.mc-modal-drag-grip {
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -1px;
  opacity: 0.65;
  transition: opacity 120ms ease;
}

.mc-modal-floating .mc-modal-head:hover .mc-modal-drag-grip {
  opacity: 1;
}

.mc-modal-floating form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
}

.mc-modal-floating .mc-modal-body {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  max-height: none;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.mc-modal-floating .mc-field-grow {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 112px;
}

.mc-modal-floating .mc-textarea {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 92px;
  resize: none;
}

.mc-modal-floating .mc-modal-foot {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-bottom-left-radius: var(--r-xl);
  border-bottom-right-radius: var(--r-xl);
}

.mc-resize-handle {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 4;
  touch-action: none;
}

.mc-resize-n {
  top: -4px;
  left: 10px;
  right: 10px;
  height: 8px;
  cursor: ns-resize;
}

.mc-resize-s {
  bottom: -4px;
  left: 10px;
  right: 10px;
  height: 8px;
  cursor: ns-resize;
}

.mc-resize-e {
  top: 10px;
  bottom: 10px;
  right: -4px;
  width: 8px;
  cursor: ew-resize;
}

.mc-resize-w {
  top: 10px;
  bottom: 10px;
  left: -4px;
  width: 8px;
  cursor: ew-resize;
}

.mc-resize-nw {
  top: -5px;
  left: -5px;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  cursor: nwse-resize;
}

.mc-resize-ne {
  top: -5px;
  right: -5px;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  cursor: nesw-resize;
}

.mc-resize-sw {
  bottom: -5px;
  left: -5px;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  cursor: nesw-resize;
}

.mc-resize-se {
  bottom: -4px;
  right: -4px;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  cursor: nwse-resize;
}

.mc-resize-se::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: 6px;
  bottom: 6px;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-right: 1.75px solid var(--mc-fg-muted);
  border-bottom: 1.75px solid var(--mc-fg-muted);
  border-bottom-right-radius: 2px;
  opacity: 0.55;
  transition: opacity 120ms ease;
}

.mc-resize-se:hover::after,
.mc-modal-floating.is-resizing .mc-resize-se::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Command Palette */
.mc-palette-input-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
}

.mc-palette-input {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  font-size: 13.5px;
}

.mc-palette-list {
  max-height: 360px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 6px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.mc-palette-item {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  text-align: left;
  color: var(--mc-fg-2);
}

.mc-palette-item:hover,
.mc-palette-item.active {
  background: var(--mc-surface-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-palette-kind {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 1px 6px;
}

/* Switch / Toggle */
.mc-setting-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.mc-toggle-group {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: 2px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
}

.mc-toggle-btn {
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  padding: 4px 9px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.mc-toggle-btn.active {
  background: var(--mc-tab-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

/* Toasts */
.mc-toast-root {
  position: fixed;
  top: 14px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 80;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.mc-toast {
  padding: 9px 13px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border-active);
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.mc-toast.tone-red {
  border-color: var(--mc-red-border);
  color: var(--mc-red-text);
}

.mc-toast.tone-green {
  border-color: var(--mc-green-border);
  color: var(--mc-green-text);
}

@keyframes mc-spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.mc-icon.is-spinning {
  animation: none;
}

/* Usage & Quota View */
.mc-section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.mc-section-label {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.mc-section-count {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;

  border-radius: 999px;
}

.mc-section-count.tone-amber {
  background: var(--mc-amber-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-amber-border);
  color: var(--mc-amber-text);
}

.mc-usage-view {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  padding-bottom: 16px;
}

.mc-usage-hero-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 11px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  background: var(--mc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
}

.mc-usage-hero-left,
.mc-usage-hero-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.mc-usage-hero-stats,
.mc-usage-updated {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

.mc-usage-unavailable {
  padding: 40px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);

  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.mc-usage-unavail-icon {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--mc-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border);

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.mc-usage-unavail-actions {
  display: flex;

  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
}

.mc-usage-pools-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

.mc-pool-card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 15px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);

.mc-pool-card::before {
  content: "";

  left: 0;

.mc-pool-card.tone-green::before {

}

.mc-pool-card.tone-amber::before {
  background: var(--mc-amber);
}

.mc-pool-card.tone-red::before {
  background: var(--mc-red);
}

.mc-pool-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--mc-border-active);
}

.mc-pool-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
}

.mc-pool-title-wrap {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.mc-pool-name {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.mc-pool-providers {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.mc-pool-metrics {

  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;

  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.mc-pool-pct-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 6px;
}

.mc-pool-pct {
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: var(--mc-fg);
}

.mc-pool-pct-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
}

.mc-pool-used {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-faint);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.mc-pool-reset {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.mc-pool-reset .mc-icon {
  width: 13px;
  height: 13px;
  color: var(--mc-fg-faint);
}

.mc-meter-track {
  width: 100%;

  border-radius: 999px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mc-border-subtle);
  overflow: hidden;

.mc-meter-track.is-compact {
  width: 116px;

  flex: none;
}

.mc-meter-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--mc-gray);
  transition: width 0.25s ease;
}

.mc-meter-fill.tone-green {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #10b981, var(--mc-green));
}

.mc-meter-fill.tone-amber {

.mc-meter-fill.tone-red {

.mc-pool-families {

.mc-window-head .mc-pool-reset {

.mc-window-label {

  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

.mc-window-block.is-weekly .mc-window-label {
  color: var(--mc-blue-text);
}

.mc-window-metrics {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.mc-window-pct {
  font-size: 22px;

  line-height: 1;

  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

}

.mc-window-used {
  margin-left: auto;

  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--mc-fg-muted);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.mc-window-block.is-weekly .mc-window-used {

.mc-usage-note {

.mc-pool-family-chip {

.mc-usage-credits-grid {

}

.mc-credit-card {

.mc-credit-label {

.mc-credit-value {

.mc-credit-sub {

.mc-usage-models-bar {

.mc-usage-models-head-left {

.mc-usage-models-bar .mc-filter-group {

.mc-model-meter-list {

.mc-model-meter-row:last-child {

}

.mc-model-meter-row:hover {

}

.mc-model-meter-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;

  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

.mc-model-meter-title-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;

  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.mc-model-meter-name {
  font-size: 13px;

.mc-model-meter-meta {

.mc-model-thinking-list {

.mc-thinking-pill {

.mc-model-meter-right {

.mc-model-pct {

  font-size: 12.5px;

.mc-model-pct.tone-green {

.mc-model-pct.tone-amber {

.mc-model-pct.tone-red {

.mc-model-pct.tone-muted {

        });

      for (const handle of modalEl.querySelectorAll("[data-modal-resize]")) {
        const dir = handle.dataset.modalResize || "";
        handle.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
          if (e.button !== 0) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          modalBackdropPointerDown = false;
          const startX = e.clientX;
          const startY = e.clientY;
          const startRect = state.newThreadModalRect || getDefaultNewThreadRect(modalEl);
          const vw = window.innerWidth;
          const vh = window.innerHeight;
          modalEl.classList.add("is-resizing");
          handle.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);

          const onMove = (ev) => {
            const dx = ev.clientX - startX;
            const dy = ev.clientY - startY;
            let { left, top, width, height } = startRect;

            if (dir.includes("e")) {
              width = Math.min(
                vw - FLOATING_MODAL_PAD - left,
                Math.max(FLOATING_MODAL_MIN_W, startRect.width + dx),
              );
            }
            if (dir.includes("s")) {
              height = Math.min(
                vh - FLOATING_MODAL_PAD - top,
                Math.max(FLOATING_MODAL_MIN_H, startRect.height + dy),
              );
            }
            if (dir.includes("w")) {
              const right = startRect.left + startRect.width;
              const nextLeft = Math.max(
                FLOATING_MODAL_PAD,
                Math.min(right - FLOATING_MODAL_MIN_W, startRect.left + dx),
              );
              left = nextLeft;
              width = right - nextLeft;
            }
            if (dir.includes("n")) {
              const bottom = startRect.top + startRect.height;
              const nextTop = Math.max(
                FLOATING_MODAL_PAD,
                Math.min(bottom - FLOATING_MODAL_MIN_H, startRect.top + dy),
              );
              top = nextTop;
              height = bottom - nextTop;
            }

            applyFloatingModalRect(modalEl, { left, top, width, height });
          };

          const onUp = (ev) => {
            modalEl.classList.remove("is-resizing");
            if (handle.hasPointerCapture?.(ev.pointerId)) {
              handle.releasePointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
            }
            handle.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
            handle.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
            handle.removeEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);
          };

          handle.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
          handle.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
          handle.addEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);
        });
      }
    }

    function openNewThreadModal(projectId = "") {
      if (!state.snap?.projects?.length) {
        showToast(
          state.snap ? "Add a project in Phoenix first." : "Projects are still loading.",
          "amber",
        );
        return;
      }
      closeSettingsPopover();
      state.modal = { type: "new-thread", projectId };
      const root = $("mc-modal-root");
      root.innerHTML = renderNewThreadModal(state.snap, { projectId });
      root.classList.remove("hidden");
      initFloatingModal($("mc-new-thread-modal"));
      $("mc-nt-prompt")?.focus();
    }

    function openPaletteModal() {
      closeSettingsPopover();
      const query = "";
      const items = buildPaletteItems(state.snap, query);
      state.modal = { type: "palette", query, index: 0, items };
      const root = $("mc-modal-root");
      root.innerHTML = renderCommandPalette(items, query, 0);
      root.classList.remove("hidden");
      $("mc-palette-input")?.focus();
    }

    function updatePalette(query) {
      if (state.modal?.type !== "palette") return;
      const items = buildPaletteItems(state.snap, query);
      state.modal.query = query;
      state.modal.items = items;
      state.modal.index = Math.min(state.modal.index, Math.max(0, items.length - 1));
      const list = $("mc-palette-list");
      if (!list) return;
      const temp = document.createElement("div");
      temp.innerHTML = renderCommandPalette(items, query, state.modal.index);
      const nextList = temp.querySelector("#mc-palette-list");
      if (nextList) list.innerHTML = nextList.innerHTML;
    }

    function closeModal() {
      state.modal = null;
      $("mc-modal-root").classList.add("hidden");
      $("mc-modal-root").innerHTML = "";
    }

    function runPaletteItem(item) {
      if (!item?.action) return;
      closeModal();
      const act = item.action;
      if (act.type === "new-thread") openNewThreadModal(act.projectId || "");
      else if (act.type === "open-plugins") openPluginsDrawer();
      else if (act.type === "view") setView(act.view);
      else if (act.type === "thread") selectThread(act.threadId);
    }

    function setView(view) {
      state.view = VALID_VIEWS.has(view) ? view : "inbox";
      renderRail();
      renderHeader();
      syncBackdrop();
      renderActiveView();
      if (
        state.view === "usage" &&
        (!state.usage || Date.now() - state.usageFetchedAt >= USAGE_POLL_MS)
      ) {
        loadUsage(false);
      }
    }

    function setFilter(filter) {
      state.filter = filter;
      renderHeader();
      renderActiveView();
    }

    function attentionItem(threadId) {
      return [
        ...(state.snap?.needsAttention ?? []),
        ...(state.snap?.snoozedAttention ?? []),
        ...(state.snap?.acceptedAttention ?? []),
        ...(state.snap?.dismissedAttention ?? []),
      ].find((item) => item.threadId === threadId);
    }

    async function triageThread(threadId, disposition, undoing = false, expected = null) {
      if (disposition === "review") {
        handleOpenFull(threadId);
        return;
      }
      if (state.mutationInFlight) return;
      const item = attentionItem(threadId);
      const card = findProjectForThread(threadId)?.threads?.find((thread) => thread.id === threadId);
      if (!item && !card) {
        showToast("Refresh the inbox before changing this item.", "amber");
        return;
      }
      const expectedLatestRunId = expected
        ? expected.latestRunId
        : (item?.latestRunId ?? card?.latestRunId ?? null);
      const expectedRequestId = expected
        ? expected.requestId
        : (item?.pendingRequestId ?? card?.pendingRequestId ?? null);
      state.mutationInFlight = true;
      renderActiveView();
      renderInspector(true);
      try {
        await fetchJson("/api/triage", {
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            threadId,
            disposition,
            expectedLatestRunId,
            expectedRequestId,
            ...(disposition === "snooze"
              ? { snoozedUntil: new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() }
              : {}),
          }),
        });
        const reverse = {
          accept: "reopen",
          dismiss: "reopen",
          reopen: item?.dismissed || card?.dismissed ? "dismiss" : "accept",
          snooze: "unsnooze",
          unsnooze: "snooze",
        }[disposition];
        state.triageUndo = undoing
          ? null
          : {
              threadId,
              disposition: reverse,
              expectedLatestRunId,
              expectedRequestId,
            };
        state.etag = "";
        await pollDashboard(true);
        renderTriageUndo();
      } catch (error) {
        showToast(error.message || "This item changed. Refresh and try again.", "red");
        await pollDashboard(true);
      } finally {
        state.mutationInFlight = false;
        renderActiveView();
        renderInspector(true);
      }
    }

    function renderTriageUndo() {
      const root = $("mc-undo");
      if (!root) return;
      root.classList.toggle("hidden", !state.triageUndo);
    }

    async function undoTriage() {
      const last = state.triageUndo;
      if (!last) return;
      const current =
        attentionItem(last.threadId) ??
        findProjectForThread(last.threadId)?.threads?.find((thread) => thread.id === last.threadId);
      if (
        !current ||
        (current.latestRunId ?? null) !== last.expectedLatestRunId ||
        (current.pendingRequestId ?? null) !== last.expectedRequestId
      ) {
        state.triageUndo = null;
        renderTriageUndo();
        showToast("New work arrived. Review the current item before changing it.", "amber");
        return;
      }
      await triageThread(last.threadId, last.disposition, true, {
        latestRunId: last.expectedLatestRunId,
        requestId: last.expectedRequestId,
      });
    }

    function nextAttention() {
      const items = state.snap?.needsAttention ?? [];
      if (!items.length) return;
      const index = items.findIndex((item) => item.threadId === state.selectedThreadId);
      const next = items[(index + 1) % items.length];
      state.inboxScope = "active";
      if (next) selectThread(next.threadId, { tab: "activity", openDrawer: true });
    }

    async function controlThread(threadId, command) {
      if (state.mutationInFlight || state.detail?.id !== threadId) return;
      const expectedRunId = state.detail.activeRunId ?? state.detail.latestRunId;
      if (!expectedRunId) return;
      state.mutationInFlight = true;
      renderInspector(true);
      try {
        await fetchJson("/api/control", {
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify({ threadId, command, expectedRunId }),
        });
        state.etag = "";
        await pollDashboard(true);
      } catch (error) {
        showToast(error.message || "The run changed. Refresh before retrying.", "red");
      } finally {
        state.mutationInFlight = false;
        renderInspector(true);
      }
    }

    async function selectThread(threadId, opts = {}) {
      if (!threadId) return;
      if (state.view === "usage") {
        state.view = "inbox";
        renderRail();
        renderHeader();
      }
      const changed = state.selectedThreadId !== threadId;
      state.selectedThreadId = threadId;
      if (changed) {
        state.detail = null;
        state.detailError = null;
        state.composerDraft = drafts.get(threadId);
        state.composerModel = "";
        state.composerMode = "";
        state.composerSendMode = "queue";
        state.inspectorDiffFile = "all";
      }
      if (opts.tab) state.inspectorTab = opts.tab;
      if (window.innerWidth < 1100) state.inspectorOpen = true;

      renderActiveView();
      renderInspector(true);
      await loadThreadDetail(threadId, true);
      if (opts.focusComposer && state.selectedThreadId === threadId) {
        setTimeout(() => $("mc-composer-input")?.focus(), 40);
      }
    }

    async function handleSendReply() {
      const threadId = state.selectedThreadId;
      if (!threadId || drafts.isSending(threadId) || state.detail?.id !== threadId) return;
      const input = $("mc-composer-input");
      const text = input?.value ?? state.composerDraft;
      if (!text.trim()) return;
      void drafts.set(threadId, text);
      const sendMode = $("mc-composer-send-mode")?.value || "queue";
      const expectedActiveRunId = state.detail.intervention?.expectedActiveRunId;

      try {
        const sending = drafts.send(threadId, (message) =>
          fetchJson("/api/reply", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ threadId, message, sendMode, expectedActiveRunId }),
          }),
        );
        renderInspector(true);
        await sending;
        if (state.selectedThreadId === threadId) renderInspector(true);
        state.etag = "";
        showToast(
          sendMode === "steer" ? "Steering sent" : expectedActiveRunId ? "Reply queued" : "Reply sent",
          "green",
        );
        await pollDashboard(true);
      } catch (err) {
        if (state.selectedThreadId === threadId) renderInspector(true);
        showToast(err.message || "Failed to send reply", "red");
      }
    }

    async function handleCreateThread(form) {
      const fd = new FormData(form);
      const projectId = String(fd.get("projectId") || "").trim();
      const title = String(fd.get("title") || "").trim();
      const prompt = String(fd.get("prompt") || "").trim();

      if (!projectId || !prompt) {
        showToast("Project and prompt are required", "red");
        return;
      }

      const submitBtn = $("mc-nt-submit");
      if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;

      try {
        const res = await fetchJson("/api/threads/new", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            projectId,
            title: title || undefined,
            prompt,
            model: String(fd.get("model") || ""),
          }),
        });
        closeModal();
        showToast("Thread launched", "green");
        state.etag = "";
        if (res.threadId) {
          await selectThread(res.threadId, { tab: "activity" });
        }
        await pollDashboard(true);
      } catch (err) {
        if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
        showToast(err.message || "Failed to start thread", "red");
      }
    }

    function handleOpenFull(threadId) {
      if (!threadId) return;
      if (window.phoenix?.ui?.toggleConversation) {
        window.phoenix.ui.toggleConversation(threadId);
        return;
      }
      if (window.innerWidth < 1100) state.inspectorOpen = true;
      state.inspectorTab = "activity";
      renderInspector(true);
      showToast("Opened full thread inspector");
    }

    function handleOpenFile(relPath) {
      const proj = state.detail ? findProjectForThread(state.detail.id) : null;
      if (window.phoenix?.ui?.toggleAuxPane && proj?.path) {
        const cleanBase = proj.path.replace(/\/+$/, "");
        const cleanRel = String(relPath || "").replace(/^\/+/, "");
        window.phoenix.ui.toggleAuxPane({
          tabType: "fileView",
          uri: `file://${cleanBase}/${cleanRel}`,
        });
        return;
      }
      state.inspectorTab = "diff";
      state.inspectorDiffFile = relPath;
      renderInspector(true);
    }

    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
      modalBackdropPointerDown = e.target === $("mc-modal-root");
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const railView = e.target.closest("[data-rail-view]");
      if (railView) {
        closePluginsDrawer();
        closeSettingsPopover();
        setView(railView.dataset.railView);
        return;
      }

      const segBtn = e.target.closest("#mc-view-tabs .mc-seg-btn");
      if (segBtn) {
        setView(segBtn.dataset.view);
        return;
      }

      const filterPill = e.target.closest("#mc-filters .mc-filter-pill");
      if (filterPill) {
        setFilter(filterPill.dataset.filter);
        return;
      }

      const usageFilterBtn = e.target.closest("[data-usage-filter]");
      if (usageFilterBtn) {
        state.usageFilter = usageFilterBtn.dataset.usageFilter || "all";
        renderActiveView();
        return;
      }

      const usageModeBtn = e.target.closest("[data-usage-mode]");
      if (usageModeBtn) {
        state.usageMode = usageModeBtn.dataset.usageMode === "variants" ? "variants" : "families";
        renderActiveView();
        return;
      }

      const triage = e.target.closest("[data-triage-action]");
      if (triage) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        void triageThread(triage.dataset.threadId, triage.dataset.triageAction, false, {
          latestRunId: triage.dataset.runId || null,
          requestId: triage.dataset.requestId || null,
        });
        return;
      }
      const control = e.target.closest("[data-control-thread]");
      if (control) {
        void controlThread(control.dataset.controlThread, control.dataset.controlAction);
        return;
      }
      const inboxScope = e.target.closest("[data-inbox-scope]");
      if (inboxScope) {
        state.inboxScope = inboxScope.dataset.inboxScope;
        renderActiveView();
        return;
      }
      const attAction = e.target.closest("[data-attention-action]");
      if (attAction) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const act = attAction.dataset.attentionAction;
        const threadId = attAction.dataset.threadId;
        if (act === "dismiss") void triageThread(threadId, "dismiss");
        else if (act === "diff") selectThread(threadId, { tab: "diff", openDrawer: true });
        else if (act === "reply")
          selectThread(threadId, { tab: "activity", openDrawer: true, focusComposer: true });
        else if (act === "open") {
          selectThread(threadId, { tab: "activity", openDrawer: true });
          handleOpenFull(threadId);
        } else selectThread(threadId, { tab: "activity", openDrawer: true });
        return;
      }

      const openFileBtn = e.target.closest("[data-open-file]");
      if (openFileBtn) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        handleOpenFile(openFileBtn.dataset.openFile);
        return;
      }

      const jumpDiff = e.target.closest("[data-jump-diff]");
      if (jumpDiff) {
        state.inspectorTab = "diff";
        state.inspectorDiffFile = jumpDiff.dataset.jumpDiff;
        renderInspector(true);
        return;
      }

      const diffChip = e.target.closest("[data-diff-file]");
      if (diffChip) {
        state.inspectorDiffFile = diffChip.dataset.diffFile;
        renderInspector(true);
        return;
      }

      const inspTab = e.target.closest("[data-insp-tab]");
      if (inspTab) {
        state.inspectorTab = inspTab.dataset.inspTab;
        renderInspector(true);
        return;
      }

      const openConv = e.target.closest("[data-open-conv]");
      if (openConv) {
        window.phoenix?.ui?.toggleConversation?.(openConv.dataset.openConv);
        return;
      }

      const newProjBtn = e.target.closest("[data-new-thread-project]");
      if (newProjBtn) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        openNewThreadModal(newProjBtn.dataset.newThreadProject);
        return;
      }

      const selThread = e.target.closest("[data-select-thread]");
      if (selThread) {
        selectThread(selThread.dataset.selectThread, { openDrawer: true });
        return;
      }

      const paletteBtn = e.target.closest("[data-palette-idx]");
      if (paletteBtn && state.modal?.type === "palette") {
        const item = state.modal.items?.[Number(paletteBtn.dataset.paletteIdx)];
        runPaletteItem(item);
        return;
      }

      if (
        e.target.closest("[data-close-modal]") ||
        (e.target === $("mc-modal-root") && modalBackdropPointerDown)
      ) {
        modalBackdropPointerDown = false;
        closeModal();
        return;
      }

      const actionEl = e.target.closest("[data-action]");
      if (actionEl) {
        const action = actionEl.dataset.action;
        if (action === "next-attention") nextAttention();
        else if (action === "undo-triage") void undoTriage();
        else if (action === "new-thread") openNewThreadModal("");
        else if (action === "toggle-plugins") {
          if (state.pluginsOpen) closePluginsDrawer();
          else openPluginsDrawer();
        } else if (action === "close-plugins") closePluginsDrawer();
        else if (action === "toggle-settings") toggleSettingsPopover();
        else if (action === "close-settings") closeSettingsPopover();
        else if (action === "refresh-usage") loadUsage(true);
        else if (action === "clear-filters") {
          state.filter = "all";
          state.search = "";
          if ($("mc-search")) $("mc-search").value = "";
          renderHeader();
          renderActiveView();
        } else if (action === "retry-poll") {
          pollDashboard(true);
        } else if (action === "close-inspector") {
          state.inspectorOpen = false;
          renderInspector(false);
        } else if (action === "open-full") {
          handleOpenFull(actionEl.dataset.threadId);
        }
        return;
      }

      if (e.target === $("mc-backdrop")) {
        closePluginsDrawer();
        state.inspectorOpen = false;
        renderInspector(false);
        return;
      }

      if (
        state.settingsOpen &&
        !e.target.closest("#mc-settings-popover") &&
        !e.target.closest('[data-action="toggle-settings"]')
      ) {
        closeSettingsPopover();
      }
    });

    $("mc-new-thread-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => openNewThreadModal(""));
    $("mc-cmdk-trigger")?.addEventListener("click", openPaletteModal);

    $("mc-search")?.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
      state.search = e.target.value;
      renderActiveView();
    });

    document.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
      if (e.target.id === "mc-composer-input") {
        state.composerDraft = e.target.value;
        if (state.detail?.id === state.selectedThreadId)
          void drafts.set(state.selectedThreadId, e.target.value);
        autoResizeTextarea(e.target);
      } else if (e.target.id === "mc-palette-input") {
        updatePalette(e.target.value);
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
      if (e.target.id === "mc-composer-model") {
        state.composerModel = e.target.value;
      } else if (e.target.id === "mc-composer-mode") {
        state.composerMode = e.target.value;
      } else if (e.target.id === "mc-composer-send-mode") {
        state.composerSendMode = e.target.value;
      } else if (e.target.id === "mc-poll-select") {
        state.pollMs = Number(e.target.value) || 0;
        resetPollTimer();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
      if (e.target.id === "mc-composer-form") {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSendReply();
      } else if (e.target.id === "mc-new-thread-form") {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleCreateThread(e.target);
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (state.modal?.type === "palette") closeModal();
        else openPaletteModal();
        return;
      }

      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        if (state.modal) {
          e.preventDefault();
          closeModal();
        } else if (state.settingsOpen) {
          e.preventDefault();
          closeSettingsPopover();
        } else if (state.pluginsOpen) {
          e.preventDefault();
          closePluginsDrawer();
        } else if (state.inspectorOpen) {
          e.preventDefault();
          state.inspectorOpen = false;
          renderInspector(false);
        }
        return;
      }

      if (state.modal?.type === "palette") {
        const items = state.modal.items || [];
        if (e.key === "ArrowDown" && items.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          state.modal.index = (state.modal.index + 1) % items.length;
          updatePalette(state.modal.query);
        } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp" && items.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          state.modal.index = (state.modal.index - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
          updatePalette(state.modal.query);
        } else if (e.key === "Enter" && items.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          runPaletteItem(items[state.modal.index]);
        }
        return;
      }

      if (e.target?.id === "mc-composer-input" && e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSendReply();
        return;
      }

      if (e.key === "Enter" && e.target?.matches("[data-select-thread], [data-jump-diff]")) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.target.click();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      if (window.innerWidth >= 1100 && state.inspectorOpen) {
        state.inspectorOpen = false;
      }
      if (state.modal?.type === "new-thread" && state.newThreadModalRect) {
        applyFloatingModalRect($("mc-new-thread-modal"), state.newThreadModalRect);
      }
      syncBackdrop();
    });

    window.addEventListener("error", (e) => {
      if (!state.snap || $("mc-subtitle")?.textContent?.startsWith("Loading")) {
        renderFatalError("Mission Control failed to initialize", e?.message || "Script error");
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e) => {
      if (!state.snap || $("mc-subtitle")?.textContent?.startsWith("Loading")) {
        const msg = e?.reason?.message || String(e?.reason || "Unhandled promise rejection");
        renderFatalError("Mission Control failed to initialize", msg);
      }
    });

    try {
      renderRail();
      renderHeader();
      if (state.view === "usage") {
        renderActiveView();
        loadUsage(false);
      }
      pollDashboard(true);
      resetPollTimer();
    } catch (err) {
      renderFatalError("Mission Control failed to start", err?.message || String(err));
    }

    window.addEventListener("phoenix-error", (event) => showToast(event.detail, "red"));

    return {  };
  })();
})();
